programme.desc: An interactive programme that's as fun as it is informative and reactive to the meteorological events of the moment. programme.title: E5 - Oisans
programme.desc: In Oisans, a natural region in the French Alps, Cecile Andrieux harvests a perennial high-mountain plant called 'genepi'. At his farm in Mizoens, Colin Bonnard combines animal rearing and vegetable growing. All there is to know about the protection of the yellow-bellied toad and mountain lakes as places of transmission.

programme.desc: How is a haute couture collection created? Stephane Rolland reveals behind the scenes of a season inspired by the iconic Dalida. programme.title: E10 - 島外約會爭奪戰高能開啟
programme.desc: 22位單身男女為愛而來，隻身抵達遠離都市的荒野之境，展開為期14天的偏愛之戀旅程；當生存競技撞上戀愛修羅場，淘汰危機和情感抉擇之下，一場麫包與玫瑰的較量即將展開，他們能否找到屬於自己的愛與偏愛？

programme.title: E8 - 謝娜李維嘉蔣一僑爆笑整活
programme.desc: 聚焦女性主題生活觀察真人秀，邀請了謝娜、董璇、王琳與萬千惠為姐姐團成員，透過她們在「當家」過程中所面對的現實困境，探討與女性相關的選擇、情感、家庭等議題，激發出每一位女性的幽默、堅持和勇氣。

programme.title: E2 - 帥哥美女泳池曖昧貼貼
programme.desc: 以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此。

programme.title: E7 - 經理人為保優秀學員開啟換人
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星。

programme.title: E4 - 冉瑩穎鄒市明雙向告白
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。

programme.title: E1 - 高瀚宇周震南抬價上頭被反殺
programme.desc: 30組新銳潮玩設計師帶著自己的原創IP，與高瀚宇、何廣智、賴美雲、謝可寅、周揚青、周震南組成3組潮玩工作室，經歷一系列主題創作，在創意與設計中不斷挑戰自我、團結協作，用繪畫表達語言，賦予這些潮流新興IP更具生命力的藝術價值，也讓更多「隱藏款」原創IP和寶藏設計師被看到。

programme.title: E11
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: E5 - 古器新唱法
programme.desc: 邀請文博愛好者組成「文物代言人」，通過多元形式演繹國寶故事；以舞台創演、文創開發的創新形式，搭建起傳統文化與年輕群體的溝通橋樑，為文化傳承注入青春活力與澎湃動能。

programme.title: E21
programme.desc: 「申二朗」律師在舊巫堂開設法律事務所後，開始看得見鬼魂。雖然外表沉穩可靠，但實際上膽小又有些冒失；然而在面對帶著冤屈的鬼魂委託人時，卻展現出誰也無法動搖的堅定氣度。他與菁英律師「韓娜賢」以「法律」為武器替非常特別的委託人洗刷冤屈。

programme.desc: Tess is in over her head when she agrees to mentor a newly blind teenager for Mia while investigating a killer-or killers - using untraceable 3D printed ghost guns. Blood and killers? Sure. Moody teenagers? Hell no. As Tess and Sunny realize this is the work of two murderers working together despite not knowing each other, Sunny celebrates small wins as her therapist has taught her. Carried away by her healing journey, Sunny impulsively reaches out to her long lost mother, while Jake contacts Tess with a dangerous request.

programme.title: E10 - Rekindling
programme.desc: Amidst the effervescence of Lucas's wedding day, Tess plays with fire as she uses Jake's undercover investigation to get close to the man she holds responsible for her mother's death. In this epic finale, Tess must challenge everything she thought she knew about her past to finally learn the truth about the fire that killed her mother and separated her from Lucas. Meanwhile, after spontaneously reaching out to her estranged mother in 209, Sunny continues to push boundaries in an attempt to convince herself she is cured, first sleeping with Kye, and then inviting the wolf to her door in the form of her mother – with unexpected consequences.

programme.title: E7 - Japan
programme.desc: After Bangladesh, Rooftop and Catfish explore the country of Japan next. They test out their careers as sumo wrestlers and ninjas (though they learn they should probably stick to BMX), eat pufferfish, a delicacy outlawed everywhere else in Asia, and try to handle Japan’s bondage culture from a dominatrix. They join in on a game of Bo Taoshi, and get saline injections to fit in with Japan’s nightlife. Before they head out from their Japanese adventures, Rooftop and Catfish finish the trip learning how to drift and even attempt jumping into their drifting car. After such an action packed visit to Japan, where will the duo’s travels take them next?

programme.title: E8 - Indonesia
programme.desc: Rooftop and Catfish explore Indonesia in a fiery way. The duo test out their manhoods with leech therapy, wall jumping, participating in a traditional whip dance, and trying the ancient martial art of debus. They then slow down for a moment to stop and smell the Indonesian fruit durian and cut one out of a tree to taste test. Finally their Indonesian adventure ends with a game of flaming soccer in the streets and sulfur mining in the mouth of a volcano. With all of these wild and dangerous activities, can Rooftop and Catfish handle the heat of Indonesia?

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 3x World Surf Champion turned wildlife conservationist Mick Fanning teams up with leading experts in new documentary SAVE THIS SHARK. Mick Fanning is on a new mission to explore shark conservation. The 3x world surfing champion will hop around the world teaming up with experts and conservationists to uncover the hidden truths about sharks, threats and how to save them from extinction. Mick will investigate the issue of sharks versus people and present problems as well as discover the latest technological solutions in how to keep both humans and sharks safe to coexist. Our host has had some incredible achievements throughout his professional career, but one moment stood out to the world live on television in 2015. The duo test out their manhoods with leech therapy, wall jumping, participating in a traditional whip dance, and trying the ancient martial art of debus. They then slow down for a moment to stop and smell the Indonesian fruit durian and cut one out of a tree to taste test. Finally their Indonesian adventure ends with a game of flaming soccer in the streets and sulfur mining in the mouth of a volcano. With all of these wild and dangerous activities, can Rooftop and Catfish handle the heat of Indonesia?

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: E37
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。

programme.title: E2
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: Let's Sing Along
programme.desc: Chu Wai Tak is a natural born introvert, a white collar worker who suffers from a serious lack of self confidence. Her greatest achievement at work is 'using 10% less toilet paper than yesterday' and saving several more cents. King's self confidence is at its peak as he has crowned himself the King of Karaoke. He becomes exhausted if he does not go to the karaoke box and sing for a few days. King loves to gain attention at the company and has indeed brought a lot of energy to a boring company.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Lau Ching Wan: Life Without Principle
programme.desc: “Life Without Principle” tells the story of three ordinary citizens, bank teller Teresa, triad thug Panther and Police inspector Cheung Jin Fong, whose lives are turned upside down by a bizarre robbery. Hammered by the predicaments of their respective lives, what are their choices between money and principles?

programme.title: Showbiz Spy
programme.desc: Cercis Lui goes undercover in this lively comedy as an officer of the 'International Association for the Physical and Mental Health Development of Underage Boys and Girls” dedicated to protecting young boys and girls from being exploited in their pursuit of pop stardom. When tasked with taking down a shady talent show and its mastermind, Big Boss, Cercis must disguise himself as a woman to enter the competition. Only then can he get close enough to gather the evidence to take down the criminal ring. Joining this outlandish operation are Helianthus - an entertainment reporter, Circle O – a wannabe popstar, Lilium - a notorious artist and Oval O – cousin of Circle O from the US. But does this ragtag team have what it takes to triumph over the shady side of the business?

programme.title: Twilight Online
programme.desc: In 2003, a collision between a double-decker bus and a truck in Tuen Mun took the lives of 21 people. Ten years after the accident, several tenants on the Yau Oi Estate, which is located near the scene of the collision, report witnessing a woman clad in red jumping to her death on multiple nights, prompting veteran police officer Gu to go investigate with rookie cop Bee At the same time, radio DJ Poon Siu Chung returns to the site of the Tuen Mun collision with a group of students hoping to investigate the circumstances of the crash. When strange things start happening to the students, Gu and Bee are called to help. The two seemingly unconnected investigations converge as Gu realizes the incidents are connected.
